fcb1e1851494c7ce.title: A consensus roadmap from the SENESCENCE2030 network towards precision senescence medicine
digest: At the SENESCENCE2030 Annual Conference and Industry–Academia Workshop held in Coimbra, Portugal, in May 2026, researchers, clinicians, industry representatives and policy stakeholders identified the major priorities required to translate recent advances in cellular senescence research into clinical practice.

The resulting roadmap emphasizes the need to establish functional classifications of senescent states, develop standardized and clinically actionable biomarkers, advance precision senescence medicine, strengthen translational and regulatory frameworks, and promote international collaboration.

3fd811a6610ef1dc.title: Mapping structural aging across human tissues reveals tissue-specific trajectories and coordinated deterioration
digest: develop a framework that quantifies tissue structural aging without training on chronological age, using a large dataset of human histology images.
They reveal distinct yet coordinated organ aging trajectories, and link accelerated aging to pathways, genetic variants and pathology.

6592484bbf3189a0.title: Reframing the epidemiological transition as increasing returns to tackling aging-related diseases
digest: Reframing diseases by when they occur over the lifespan reveals that aging-related diseases now dominate the global burden in every income group.
They also uniquely show increasing returns, meaning that the more we tackle them, the greater the gains.

38fb4d071b87cea5.title: Mitochondrial DNA leakage in oocytes activates cGAS-STING signaling to drive ovarian aging
digest: The cGAS-STING signaling pathway contributes to low-grade inflammation in several tissues during aging; however, its role in the ovary was unclear.

Here the authors show that aging oocytes leak mitochondrial DNA into the cytosol where it activates the cGAS-STING pathway, driving inflammatory signaling in oocytes as well as neighboring granulosa cells via cGAMP transfer.
